Definition: entity, used only adverbially, there is or are
BiblicalUsage: There is, there are, is the word that says something exists when it should not. In 2 Samuel 14:19 the woman of Tekoah tells the king, is there any that can turn to the right hand or to the left from what my lord the king has spoken, and in Micah 6:10 the prophet asks, are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the little word carries a heavy question: is there any way round what the king has said, and are the treasures of wickedness still in the house.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
